# Trade forensics — cross-market synthesis (GENERATED by backtest.trade_forensics)

Terms: [docs/GLOSSARY.md](../../docs/GLOSSARY.md).

Engine `ab6abd824` — OBSERVATIONAL, pre-registered (prereg_trade_forensics, register 84). FENCE: forensics is CANDIDATE-GENERATION ONLY — no pattern becomes a gate, filter, or recipe change without its own Q-number and forward grade; candidates are read at an operator+reviewer sitting on these files; questions minted through the front door only (closed namespace, register 54; counted trial log).

STATISTIC SHAPES (74-B): grids = per-cell medians (descriptive); separators = field count vs permutation null (win/loss labels shuffled within sentence x variant strata, 100 pinned shuffles; cell set fixed at observed measurability) plus per-cell extremity vs that null's p95; exit-efficiency and winner-MAE = descriptive medians/quantiles, DESIGN INPUTS with no null. Measurable separator cell: wins+losses >= 25 and each side >= 10; scratch = |points| < instrument median spread, excluded from labels. Exit-efficiency pools variants — the same fire appears under each management, so rows are management-outcomes, not independent fires (stated). Prices are the FUTURES leg (the journal's basis). FILL MODEL: PESSIMISTIC (inherited). ° = dimmed (below measurability), excluded from the arithmetic. COMPARISON ONLY, NEVER POOLING (register 40e): each column is its own instrument's statistic. H11 carries the standing MIS-SCALE caveat off-home (4.0pt bucket is a uk100fut value).

Survivor patterns: 467 total — 20 repeated across markets, 447 single-market glints (glints are counted, not listed; the per-market files carry them).
